_note: Genuine reviews, copied word for word from Rebel's Facebook page (export supplied 4 Oct 2026). Do not edit wording. 'tags' decide which pages show each review. Facebook reviews have no star rating, so 'rating' is omitted and they show as 'Recommends Rebel'. Add "rating": 5 only for reviews that carry a real star rating (e.g. Google).

reviews.name: Belinda Seth
